players.product: AI data-center campus leases on converted Bitcoin-mining power sites (Sandersville GA 175 MW critical IT on a 20-year triple net lease, tenant undisclosed; Sealy and Brazoria TX under exclusivity)

quarterly_data.signal: CleanSpark's Sandersville investor presentation (8-K) names the tenant: Anviran, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Meta, with Meta serving as guarantor of rent and operating expenses; Sandersville provides 175 MW of long-duration critical IT capacity to support Meta's growing AI, data-processing and communications requirements. Terms: 20-year base lease plus two 5-year tenant extension options (plus one 12-month option), 3.0% annual rent escalator, ~$6.6 billion of contracted lease payments, ~$11.9MM development cost per IT MW, Q4 2027 Phase I targeted rent commencement. Rent revenue begins November 30, 2027 after the first network hall is completed; construction completion is expected in March 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: Meta (tenant Anviran, LLC) 175 MW; ~$6.6 billion contracted; 3.0% escalator; ~$11.9MM per IT MW; rent from November 30, 2027
